macros.name: DefMultiaudienceCommand
macros.doc: The macro \DefMultiaudienceCommand{⟨new command⟩}{⟨old command⟩} can add visibility argument to {⟨old command⟩}.

macros.name: Footnote
macros.doc: The macro \Footnote{⟨audience⟩}{⟨footnote⟩} creates a footnote with the visibility determined by the {⟨audience⟩} argument.

macros.name: SetNewAudience
macros.doc: Definition of a new audience. We create a new key that switches visibility on or off.

macros.name: showto
macros.doc: The command \showto{⟨audience⟩}{⟨contents⟩} makes the {⟨contents⟩} visible (or invisible) to the current audience according to the first argument, as describes in Section 2.1.

envs.name: shownto
envs.doc: The environment \begin{shownto}{⟨audience⟩}. . . \end{shownto} makes the contents visible or invisible according to its argument.
